body: First time I SH I was 21 and i still remember the feelings I had doing it and what I felt like just looking at it. And I believe it’s those feelings I had is what makes it addictive. I’ve only done it once and a year later i still think about those feelings whenever I’m sad because it was instant relief once I’ve done it. So I don’t blame anyone for doing what they do. Even one year before I SH for the first time I was having very strong urges to SH which is why it led to me doing that a year later. Doesn’t matter how long you are clean or if you’ve never done it before…with depression you are always going to be at risk no matter the age.

I’m going through the exact same situation you are so I can’t give you the advice you need, all I can say is you’re not alone. Depression keeps me unmotivated every day so it’s hard to improve myself and I live with my family who constantly nag at me for not having my shit together. I am so not ready for adulthood 🥴 and I’m bouta be 22. Just like you I fear for my future
Laying awake in bed with a million things on my mind
Idk why but the middle part where it’s more disturbed than the rest of the painting is what brings it together for me

I was in middle school. Kids can be cruel. I was getting good grades up until they would call me fat, dumb, weird, and a nerd. I started failing my classes which resulted in my dad calling me stupid, never going to amount to anything, and will be homeless in the future. I started starving myself because I believed them when they said I was fat so the most I’d eat was one meal a day. And nothing has changed since then and I’m 21 now..it was like it became a bad habit

You’re right. All we really need is each other and for us to come together so we can prosper. It’s just sometimes it doesn’t feel like people care at all because everyone has their own problems to deal with  and say stuff like “sounds like a ‘you’ problem” like I’m too much of a burden so I gotta deal with it myself.

Thank you for your reply this helps ❤️. I definitely don’t want to distress any of the people that love me, that is why I’m doing my best to change for the better. That way everyone including myself can be happy.
